text:
mia: Quick heads-up — Optimize toolkit examples in the SDK snippets are failing smoke tests after the quant profile v2 rollout. I'm drafting a one-page cheat sheet to help integrators with batching/caching/quant migration.
jonah: Can you paste the failing error? CI logs just show dtype mismatch in samplegen.
mia: stack trace snippet:
```
TypeError: expected float32 but got int8 in kvcache.apply()
  at samplegen.py:142
```
sylvia: ack. I saw this in the JS snippet too — looks like the quant profiles now yield int8 token logits in some paths. We should add explicit cast examples in both Python and JS.
kevin: CI: docs-snippet-tests failing on master after 2 PR merges. See job: https://ci.internal/runs/5621 :x:
akash: I can open a small PR to update samplegen tests to cast to float32 and add a comment. Want to coordinate with docs PR so it lands same time.
mia: Please do. My plan: 1) cheat-sheet md in docs/optimize/migration/quick-migrate.md 2) update SDK snippets in python/js examples 3) PR to docs + PR to snippets repo + update sample-tests. Target EOD for the patch. Who can review docs PR?
jonah: I'll review the docs PR. sylvia can check the JS snippet.
sylvia: Yup. I'll add a short JS snippet:
```
// explicitly convert logits to float32 for downstream KV cache ops
const logits = new Float32Array(rawLogits.buffer);
```
mia: Add an FAQ note about why this happened: 'quant profiles may emit lower-bit dtypes for memory savings; downstream code that assumes float32 will need explicit conversion or use profile compatibility layer.'
docs-bot: New PR created: docs/PR#4312 by mia — "optimize: migration cheat sheet for quant/profile dtype changes" :eyes: 
kevin: Heads-up: the internal snippets registry link changed last week. We'll need to update links in the cheat-sheet to https://snippets.redwood/internal/optimize/quick-migrate (old aliases 404). I can patch redirects but need the docs link updated to the new path.
mia: Put the new link in the draft. Also add a tiny 'rollback' note: if you need immediate stability, pin to quant-profile v1 (example: quant_profile: "v1-stable") in your config and restart the runtime.
jonah: For the Python snippet I'll use:
```
# ensure float32 for caching
logits = raw_logits.astype('float32')
```
akash: Opened PR: https://git.internal/snippets/pulls/88 with the test fix + updated sample. Requesting docs PR link for cross-reference.
mia: Thx — I'll add cross-links and drop a small "what to check" checklist: batching, kv prefix types, samplegen unit, CI smoke path. Everyone OK with EOD?
jonah: yes
sylvia: yes :shipit:
kevin: will push redirect for old snippet alias by 14:00 PT.
mia: Great — assigning reviewers: @jonah for docs, @sylvia for JS, @kevin for infra redirects, @akash for test changes. I'll post the final cheat-sheet when PRs are open.
jonah: ping me when the PRs are up. I'll do a quick linguist pass too (clarify 'dtype' -> 'numeric type' for non-ML readers).
sylvia: Also add a short example showing how to detect incompatible dtype in runtime logs: `kvcache dtype mismatch` and what to grep for.
mia: will do. Thanks all :heart:
